rationale: Kirill invests across AI startups and robotics through Infodriver Capital, while Kaarel is a founding ML engineer at Known.com (a $10M Forerunner-backed consumer AI startup) with deep experience shipping ML solutions and prior robotics infrastructure work at Boston Dynamics. Both are SF-based and operate at the intersection of AI and applied technology—Kirill can offer deal flow and investor perspective on scaling consumer AI, while Kaarel brings hands-on ML execution and product insights that inform venture thesis.
intro_message: Kaarel Kaarelson, meet Kirill Mishanin — you're both investing/building at the intersection of consumer AI and robotics in SF, and could swap perspectives on what's actually shippable vs. hyped in the space.
